t: From Jupyer Notebooks to FastHTML with WebSockets
s: This article discusses migrating from Jupyter Notebooks to web development, advocating for frameworks like FastHTML and tools like Nix for simplified, reproducible environments, especially for AI-assisted development.
sub: Jupyter Notebooks vs. Web Development Friction
Nix Flakes for Reproducible Development Environments
FastHTML and AI-Assisted Web Development Workflow
